summary: Took over after worker left frontend in a broken state. Removed duplicated TasksPage insertion, moved /tasks board/list into TaskDndBoard, added column-level dnd-kit droppables with optimistic PATCH rollback, passed sessionToken for task PATCH, added native chat file drop, added message drag handles targeting Tasks, and verified lint/typecheck/tests plus /members, /tasks, and /chat/all via ./twd. API finding: PATCH /api/v1/tasks/{id} requires X-Account-Token for task actor, not only X-Public-Key.

Added resizable chat thread panel matching the left chat sidebar resize behavior. The thread panel uses a left-edge separator with mouse and keyboard support, clamps width to 320-560px, and persists to localStorage key smallkhoj.chat.threadWidth. Verified via ./twd that opening a thread exposes thread-panel-resize-handle and dragging left changes width from 384 to 464.

Simplified drag UX after user testing: removed message-to-task drag handles/drop targets because message drag was low value, kept click-to-create-task action, and changed task cards to whole-card drag with cursor-grab plus hover highlight instead of a small handle button. Preserved dnd-kit keyboard listener by merging sortable key handling with Enter/Space selection. lint/typecheck/frontend tests pass; ./twd browser verification was attempted but blocked by multi-session NO_TAB/login routing.

Polished task drag interactions and added a first product-level drag action: dragging an agent DM onto a task assigns that task. Task cards now show stronger hover/drop/success feedback, use DragOverlay while moving status, synchronize selected detail on optimistic updates and rollback, and flash green after successful status or assignee PATCH. Agent DM rows expose application/x-smallkhoj-agent drag data; task cards accept that native drop and PATCH assignee. File drag remains unchanged/postponed.
